intent_en: To demonstrate the exponential growth of Berkshire Hathaway's stock price since Warren Buffett took control of the company in 1965.
previous_intent: To illustrate the dramatic increase in Berkshire Hathaway stock price over the period from 1965 to 2021.
narration_support: When Buffett took over the company in 1965, a single share was worth $19. Today, it's worth nearly half a million dollars.
chart_support: Area chart showing the stock price of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A) rising significantly from 1965 to 2021.
evidence_note: Narration describes the start and end value context (1965 vs today), chart visualizes the exponential upward trend over the same period.
